Run the existing tests and add focused tests if needed to verify the specified edge cases. Commit the completed work. Acceptance criteria: ratelimit.py fully conforms to SPEC.md; basic and relevant edge-case tests pass; no third-party dependencies; work is committed.

evidence.caption: Baseline existing tests failed at the unimplemented stubs; after implementation all seven existing and focused tests pass.

pr.body: Implemented dependency free TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter in ratelimit.py using an injected clock and OrderedDict LRU tracking. Added tests for configuration and request validation, fractional refill, non consuming wait estimates, backwards clock movement, independent buckets, and LRU behavior. All seven unittest cases, Python compilation, and git diff --check passed. No third party dependencies. Assumption: the documented positive capacity, refill rate, and max_keys inputs are numeric values.
pr.summary: Implemented full token bucket and bounded per key rate limiting. Now supports fractional refill, wait estimates, backward clock handling, and LRU eviction. Before: constructors and methods raised NotImplementedError; now the specified behavior is covered by passing tests.
